description: Shows which bookmakers carry which sports on one product, and that product's market keys (the values odds takes as markets). Filter by bookmaker or sport. Costs no tokens and sends no key.

bookmaker.description: Only this bookmaker or exchange key

limit.description: Most rows to return; a note counts the rest

product.description: standard, 2up, dutching, each-way, extra-place, bog or raw

region.description: Region code. Left out, the API uses uk.

sport.description: Only this sport, such as soccer
